notes: Prism 2.9.5: the new mark everywhere. If your taskbar button or desktop shortcut still showed Prism's old icon after 2.9.4, this update clears Windows' icon cache so they show the six-legged asterisk, the same mark as the app and the Mac. Also in this version, from 2.9.4: a new look, the meeting card and dictation pill as smooth islands, Recently deleted, your own dictation key, and notes that open at once. Free.
